text: NovaGrid Robotics has landed a fresh $42 million Series B, sources say, valuing the company at $210 million post-money -- higher than some earlier estimates. Meridian Ventures led the round. Blue Harbor Capital and Sequence Partners also joined, according to a person familiar with the deal.

Solace Health closed a $12 million Series A round this week. Northgate Capital led the round. Investors were not able to confirm the exact post-money valuation, with estimates ranging from fifty to sixty million dollars.
Ledgerline raised a $25 million Series A led by Crestwood Partners. Co-investor Anchorpoint Capital also joined the round.
